verdict.rationale: The vendor's site states that it publishes accuracy results so prospects can evaluate transcription performance before integrating. However, nothing in the evidence shows a methodology, a named benchmark dataset or reproducible test conditions behind those results, so it is unproven that they are more than bare marketing numbers. missing for 10: documented benchmark methodology, named or downloadable benchmark dataset, reported metrics such as WER per language or condition, independent or hands-on corroboration of the published results.

support.subject: As a founder, published accuracy claims come with a methodology or benchmark dataset I can check, not bare marketing numbers

citations.quote: Published accuracy results help people evaluate transcription performance before integrating.
